# Contributing

Thanks for taking the time to contribute.
Repositories with their own `CONTRIBUTING.md` override this file; follow that one instead.

## Issues

- Search existing issues before opening a new one.
- Use the issue templates and fill in every required field.

## Pull Requests

1. Fork the repository and branch from the default branch.
2. Keep each PR focused on one change.
3. Use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) for commit messages.
4. Run the project's formatter, linter and tests before pushing.
5. Fill in the pull request template and link the issue it fixes or closes.
